name: On the Money Paid Internship
org: Economic Awareness Council (with DePaul University Writing Center)
what_you_do: Research and write an article for On the Money Magazine. Teens write it, and it is about money and starting a business. You also build resume, speaking, writing and interview skills.
who_can_apply: Chicago high school students who live in the City of Chicago. No grade or age rule is listed.
pay_detail: Paid, part time. The amount and hours are not stated.
duration: Part time, September to the end of December 2026 (fall 2026 cycle). A spring internship is listed as coming next.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 interviews were tentatively in September. No closing date is stated. A spring internship is announced but its dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application form linked on the On the Money page. You can attach a resume and writing samples. Questions: iguzman@econcouncil.org (spring also kknapp@econcouncil.org).
notes: Check the page for the spring cycle. Pay amount, hours and meeting place are not listed. Illinois work permit rule not checked.
